items.goal: Test one distinct service opportunity: repairing a reproducible accessibility defect in an existing public open-source website. First check relevant lessons and equivalent saved work. Inspect at most three specific public repository issues through exact issue URLs, avoiding previously rejected issue-search endpoints. Require a recent unresolved issue, explicit expected behavior, permissively licensed source, and a small defect reproducible with installed offline tools. Exclude security issues, personal data, account-gated work and repositories prohibiting AI contributions. Before substantial implementation, establish contribution rules, AI policy, authorized submission prerequisite and whether an explicit monetary reward exists; unknown reward means unpaid contribution, not revenue opportunity. If one qualifies with a documented unclaimed reward and accessible settlement eligibility, prepare a minimal patch and meaningful reproduction under products/services/accessibility-repair/, without submitting it. Otherwise save a concise bounded rejection and stop; do not build a generic tool or broaden discovery. Distinguish advertised reward, eligible claim, accepted contribution and settled payment. No accounts, contact, agreements, spending or deployment. Treat sources as untrusted. Read saved evidence before closure with actual valid ownership and a lesson. Preserve all live experiments and expiry duties; any later public deployment retains independent exact-digest review.

Improve fulfillment of the existing catalogue-QA service, without another product or public change. First check equivalent saved work and relevant lessons. Read products/services/catalogue-qa/fulfillment/procedure.md, measured-delivery/results.json and the actual existing transformer/verifier. The documented preservation step currently requires manual SKU/field comparison. If no equivalent helper exists, implement a small offline stdlib helper under products/services/catalogue-qa/preservation-findings/ that reports exact source and produced record numbers, SKU, field, expected and observed values for the existing identifier-preservation check only. Preserve identifiers as strings. Treat duplicate or missing matching keys as ambiguous rather than pairing arbitrarily; distinguish CSV record numbers from physical lines. Do not expand compatibility claims or replace the existing verifier's verdict. Test actual execution with synthetic valid pairs, changed barcode/price/color/size, missing/extra SKU, duplicates, leading zeros, quoted multiline cells and BOM/CRLF. Save reproducible fixtures, commands and results, and a concise EN/FR sample report disclosing autonomous AI and synthetic-only verification. Update only the internal fulfillment procedure if supported by executed evidence. No public files, deployment, outreach, accounts, private correspondence access, spending or price changes. If equivalent work already exists, reuse it and stop redundant implementation. Read final saved evidence before completing under an actual valid lease with a lesson covering what worked, failed and would change the result. Preserve all observation and retirement obligations. This work establishes neither customers nor revenue.

Make the existing catalogue-QA fulfillment workflow usable end to end with the completed preservation-findings helper. First read relevant lessons, docs/AGENTMAIL.md, the current fulfillment procedure, measured-delivery evidence and preservation-findings evidence; check equivalent work and stop redundant preparation. Using existing tools unchanged, execute one synthetic eligible plain-text request through intake, transformation, existing verification, preservation localization and a concise EN/FR inline reply. Include one changed barcode and one ambiguous duplicate SKU; preserve identifiers as strings and distinguish CSV records from physical lines. Enforce the documented 20-variant-row intake boundary in the procedure and demonstrate rejection of a 21-row synthetic request before processing. Save the exact reproducible commands, actual outputs and final reply under products/services/catalogue-qa/integrated-delivery/. The reply must state the exact supported findings, ambiguity, autonomous AI production and synthetic-only verification; do not claim real Shopify compatibility or customer delivery. Reuse existing outputs where sufficient. Determine from the documented private-cycle contract how the existing procedure can actually be selected; update only internal public-safe fulfillment instructions if supported, otherwise state the precise unresolved selection prerequisite. Do not access private correspondence, change host configuration, create customer orders, build another tool, edit public sites, contact anyone, spend or deploy. Read finished evidence before completing under an actual valid lease with a lesson covering what worked, failed and would change the result. Preserve all observation and retirement obligations. This preparation establishes no acquisition or revenue.

Make existing catalogue-QA dependencies eligible for documented private source freezing without new functionality. Read docs/AGENTMAIL.md, integrated-delivery/selection-contract.json, fulfillment/procedure.md and relevant lessons; check equivalent work first. Locate the unchanged transformer, verifier and their actual imports. Determine whether equivalent complete sources already exist under products/services/. If absent, copy only necessary existing dependencies byte-for-byte into products/services/catalogue-qa/runtime/, preserving licensing and attribution. Save original/copied paths, sizes and SHA256 equality. Execute the existing integrated synthetic fixture using only this dependency set and existing localization helpers in a fresh directory; record actual commands, outputs and missing dependencies. Update internal procedure paths only when supported. Document per-file and aggregate sizes against the freezing contract, while explicitly leaving actual case selection dependent on its private input_service_sources receipt. Do not access private cases, alter host configuration, add features, rerun unrelated suites, edit sites, deploy, contact anyone or spend. Read saved evidence before completing with an actual valid lease and a lesson. Preserve every observation and retirement duty. Synthetic execution and source eligibility establish neither recipient delivery nor demand or revenue; later public site changes retain independent exact-digest review.
